parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join assays on chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3705960', then join activities on assay_id, then join molecule_dictionary on molregno, then inner join compound_structures on molregno. Filter rows where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null and standard_relation is not null. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
